pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-1620 v4 @ 3.50GHz 3.50 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo
  • Additional Notes: Best played with Keyboard & Mouse but also works with Controller
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Better than the minimum
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo
  • Additional Notes: Best played with Keyboard & Mouse but also works with Controller

short_description: A Cartoony 3D Adventure played in 3rd/1st Person! Explore a wide variety of places. Meet cool characters. Gather to build. And full of Action! Follow a weird story of an Alien Slug trying to survive Planet Earth! It's all about the FUN, WEIRD & COZY things in life!
